data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'nasiha', meaning to help, assist, advise, or support. In Islamic tradition, Nasikah symbolizes the virtue of being a helper and supporter, both in everyday life and in matters of faith. The name Nasikah carries the meaning “Helper, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nasikah usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Nasikah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper, Supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nasikah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
